fee_structure: VERIFIED 2026-10-06 against official docs (docs.polymarket.com/trading/fees.md + polymarket.com/fees): taker-only fee = C x feeRate x p x (1-p), rounded to 5 decimals (min 0.00001 USDC). Official rates: crypto 0.07, sports 0.05 (v3, 13159 events; legacy v2 0.03 on 542 events + NFL/NCAAF promo 0.03 through Oct 2026), finance/politics/mentions/tech 0.04, economics/culture/weather/general 0.05, geopolitics/world explicitly fee-free. Makers never pay; maker rebates funded by taker fees plus tiered taker rebates — rebates excluded from modeling (gross fee = conservative basis). Gamma returns per-market feeSchedule{rate,exponent,takerOnly,rebateRate}+feesEnabled: adapter reads per-market first, category table fallback, unknown -> MAX 0.07 (fail-closed). Historic zero-fee assumption is stale.
market_outcome_semantics: Binary YES/NO outcome tokens (CTF); multi-outcome via negRisk markets (negRisk flag required on orders). Fractional units allowed; min tick $0.001 (Rulebook Aug 2026). GTC/FOK/FAK order types.
settlement_rules: UMA optimistic oracle; USDC on Polygon; winning share redeems $1.00. Neg Risk Adapter relayer address retired 2026-07-17 (old redemption scripts break). Polymarket US is CFTC-approved post-2025.
rate_limits: Per IP per 10s: CLOB general 9000, /book 1500, /books 500, /prices-history 1000; Gamma 4000, /markets 300; Data API ~800-1000. Cloudflare throttles rather than rejects. Public reads need no auth; market WS channel public (PING every 10s).
geo_account_restrictions: International venue + Polymarket US (CFTC). Reads are anonymous; trading requires wallet (self-custody, EIP-712 L1 + HMAC L2). US users routed to Polymarket US.
notes: Strongest N1C candidate for read-side: free no-auth book/WS/history, generous limits. Fee model VERIFIED against official docs 2026-10-06 (supersedes N1B round-1 estimate: sports 0.03->0.05, crypto 0.072->0.07); adapter binds fee per market via feeSchedule.

fee_structure: Taker: roundup(M x 0.07 x C x P x (1-P)) to the cent, M=1 standard (S&P/Nasdaq series 0.035; crypto higher), cap $1.75/100 @ 50c. Maker: 0.0175 x C x P x (1-P) ONLY on series flagged quadratic_with_maker_fees, enabled 2026-08-19; maker multiplier defaults to 0. Ten zero-fee series. No settlement fee. Volume tiers discount taker rate. Sources: Kalshi fee schedule eff. 2026-07-07 via coinstats/kalshiview/polyKal 2026-09.
